zh.summary: 启动明显更快，更新页和更新提示更清楚。
highlights: 启动更快：同一台电脑上后台就绪约快一半。第一次启动后会记住启动要用到的模块，之后每次不再整体解压运行包，也不再用 PowerShell 查询自己刚启动的进程。运行环境较慢、杀毒软件拖慢文件读取的电脑受益更多。
更新页：整包更新后如果还没能恢复你选的内核，会说明原因；两个“启动时检查”分别写清是哪一个；安装按钮写明要装的版本；选了更旧的 Portable 时会有降级提示。
更新提示：内核还在验收时托盘里会说明不需要你做什么；整包更新说明里写明你选的内核会自动恢复；恢复内核时启动画面会显示进度；网络问题显示为一句人话，不再显示 HTTP 代码；旧的“更新失败”横幅两周后或换版本后不再显示。
upgradeNotes: 升级会保留设置、会话、插件和默认工作区。
升级后的第一次启动和以前一样慢一点（要重新学习启动用到的模块），第二次起变快。

en.summary: Noticeably faster start-up, and clearer update page and update messages.
highlights: Faster start: on the same PC the background is ready about twice as fast. After the first start it remembers the modules start-up needs instead of unpacking the whole runtime every time, and it no longer asks PowerShell about the process it just started. PCs with slow disks or antivirus scanning gain more.

Updates page: after a full update it explains why your chosen engine is not restored yet; the two startup checks say which one they control; the install button names the version; choosing an older Portable shows a downgrade hint.

Update messages: the tray explains that a core still being tested needs nothing from you; the full-update description says your chosen engine is restored; the start-up screen shows the restore; network problems read as a plain sentence instead of an HTTP code; the old 'update failed' banner disappears after two weeks or a version change.
upgradeNotes: Upgrading keeps settings, sessions, plugins, and the default workspace.
The first start after upgrading is as slow as before while it learns the start-up modules; from the second start it is faster.
